Request Water Resources Inventory Data

Use this digital version of the Department of Water's official Data Requisition Form to request specific water resources data. Complete the form, review it, sign it electronically or print and sign by hand, then submit it to the Department by email.

Please complete all sections. Incomplete forms will not be processed.
Submit to: Department of Water, Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources, Thimphu, Bhutan | Email: sdorji1@moenr.gov.bt

E. TERMS AND CONDITIONS
  1. The requested data shall be used and shared only in accordance with this Form and the Guideline for Water Resources Data and Information Request, Access and Dissemination of the Department of Water.
  2. The Department reserves the right to deny, limit, or prioritize requests where release is assessed as inappropriate or where competing requests must be managed within available capacity.
  3. Requests for nationwide-coverage data or extended observational time-scale data shall be assessed case-by-case, subject to a separate instrument of partnership.
  4. Data shall be used solely by the named applicant/institution for the stated purpose and shall not be shared with any third party, in whole or in part, without the Department's prior written consent.
  5. Reports, findings, or publications arising from use of the data shall be shared with the Department to support improvement of its data services.
  6. Data shall not be used for commercial purposes or for profit, other than reasonable recovery of the applicant's own project costs.
  7. The data source must be referenced as "Department of Water, Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources, Royal Government of Bhutan" in any resulting output.
  8. Incomplete forms will not be processed; repeated incomplete submissions without corrective action may be declined without further review.
  9. The Department disclaims all liability for any loss, damage, or claim arising from errors, inaccuracies, or results arising from use of the data provided.
